# .github/

This repository's own continuous integration and the instruction files its review bots read. Nothing here is catalog content.

- `copilot-instructions.md`, `instructions/code-review.md` and `instructions/*.instructions.md` are rendered by the bot-instructions package and each names its generator in a comment. Change `[bot-instructions]` in the effective manifest and re-render, never the file.
- `instructions/code-review.md` is this repository's whole review doctrine. `AGENTS.md` § Code Review Rules is the directive line that sends Codex there, and `copilot-instructions.md` carries the same pointer for Copilot, plus the `severity` block.
- Every job runs on a GitHub-hosted runner: the AUR, Homebrew and `request-copilot-review.yml` workflows read the fleet's `vars.CI_RUNNER_2V`, unset in this public repository, and fall back to `ubuntu-latest`.
- `skill-tests.yml` owns catalog and CLI checks. Main pushes run both; other events select them under `CI`. Keep caller content out of reusable `catalog-check.yml`.
- `skill-tests.yml` runs the suites [`../skills/AGENTS.md`](../skills/AGENTS.md) names, plus `refresh/`, `tools/` and `hooks/`. Read [CI and merge rail](../docs/architecture/merge-rail.md) before changing job selection, proof reuse or aggregation. `ci-job-set --event-parity` requires equal pull-request and merge-group selections for the same paths. `CI` holds every lane the older aggregators hold, plus Preflight and Markdown. Preflight, Markdown, doc-limits, todo-ban and the secrets scan run on pull requests alone: document and work-marker budgets must not eject a merge group, and the scan judges the commits its pull request adds. The bot-instructions check and `changelog-entries --base`, the package version rule included, run on both events.
- Before changing `actions/change-class`, its proof action or classifier wiring, read [CI and merge rail](../docs/architecture/merge-rail.md) and [the harness-ci wiring contract](../skills/harness-ci/references/wiring.md). Consumers reference `vanillagreencom/kendex/.github/actions/change-class@main`.
- `refresh-consumer.yml` is the reusable workflow consumers call through [`../refresh/kendex-refresh.yml`](../refresh/kendex-refresh.yml) at a major tag such as `v1`. It installs the release tagged on `job.workflow_sha` and runs that checkout's refresh scripts. [CI and merge rail](../docs/architecture/merge-rail.md#rules) defines catalog delivery and fallback. The major tag moves per [app-deploy](../.agents/skills/app-deploy/SKILL.md) step 4. Its suites are [`shared-refresh-workflow.test.sh`](../refresh/tests/shared-refresh-workflow.test.sh) and [`refresh-consumer.test.sh`](../refresh/tests/refresh-consumer.test.sh).
- `request-copilot-review.yml` is review-gate's central Copilot request workflow. The organization ruleset pins it from this repository. Consumers copy and render none of it. Its adoption contract is review-gate's references/automatic-review.md, and its suite is [`../skills/review-gate/tests/request-copilot-review.test.sh`](../skills/review-gate/tests/request-copilot-review.test.sh).
- `lock-record.yml` runs [`../tools/lock-record`](../tools/lock-record) on every push to `main` with a kendex built from that tree: it re-records `.kendex-lock.json` where a merge moved it and lands the record through the rolling pull request `kendex/lock`, armed with the lanes app's token from the `kendex` environment. The choice is [`../docs/decisions/D007-lock-record-on-main.md`](../docs/decisions/D007-lock-record-on-main.md); the script's suite is [`../crates/cli/tests/lock_record.rs`](../crates/cli/tests/lock_record.rs).
- `dependabot.yml` asks for security updates grouped per manifest directory and weekly action-pin version updates. The orch overseer triages each alert and a lane takes over its fix pull request, per [`../skills/orch/references/security-alerts.md`](../skills/orch/references/security-alerts.md).
- `release.yml` is the release lane [app-deploy](../.agents/skills/app-deploy/SKILL.md) § What the workflow does describes, and `publish-npm.yml` is the [npm-deploy](../.agents/skills/npm-deploy/SKILL.md) skill's trusted-publishing section, which states what renaming it breaks.
- `publish-aur.yml` and `publish-homebrew.yml` publish `packaging/`. [Publishing](../packaging/README.md#publishing) defines their triggers, dry runs and secrets. AUR release events dispatch its publisher on `main`; `release.yml` dispatches it after candidates. Homebrew follows the published release's recipe bump.
